text:
ana: Prod latency spike in eu-west affecting generation & embeddings. Platform is looking, but this may hit the scheduled webinar at 11:00 PT. Need quick decision: publish status page 'investigating' + hold webinar? @jess @tom FYI.

jess: yes, publish an "investigating" update now. suggest cadence: immediate, +15, +60. Keep copy concise, no technical root cause yet. I'll draft wording. :eyes: 

tom: ops update — we're seeing autoscaler backlog causing high GPU queue times. Mitigation rolling (scale tune + restarting a few nodes). ETA 45-90m; could be shorter. Recommend fallback to smaller model variants for hosted tier where possible.

marc: inbound lead routing: pause live webinar registration confirmations that imply fully operational demo. Route new demo requests to `incident-queue` with tag `webinar-held` and have SDRs add incident note in CRM. I'll coordinate a short email to registrants.

lucas: hold any benchmark/launch posts until we confirm stability. If we need to cancel the webinar, let's send a short empathetic note + reschedule poll. Keep public language calm and not alarm-y.

ana: (typo) — sorry, meant ana. jess, can you paste the proposed statuspage copy here so support can prep translated snippets?

jess: sure — proposed snippet: 

```
Investigating — We are aware of increased latency impacting text generation and embeddings in eu-west. Our engineers are investigating and working on mitigation. We will post updates in 15 minutes or as we have new information. No action required by customers at this time.
```

jess: suggest follow-up template for +15: short update with ETA if available or 'mitigations underway, monitoring'. For +60: either 'resolved' or 'degraded performance persists, contingency steps'.

marc: here's quick registrant email draft: "Heads up — We're experiencing service degradation in eu-west that may affect today's webinar. We're monitoring closely and will update within the hour. If we need to reschedule, you'll receive a follow-up with options. Thanks for your patience." Keep it short.

tom: ops asks that we add one line for Dedicated customers if applicable: "Customers with Dedicated deployments should see minimal impact; reach out to your CSM if you notice otherwise."

jess: noted — will include that in a separate banner for known Dedicated accounts. Also prepping small translation pack (es, fr, de) — will drop 1-line translations here.

jess: spanish translation (short): "Investigando — Hemos detectado latencia que afecta la generación de texto y embeddings en eu-west. Nuestros ingenieros investigan y publicaremos actualizaciones en 15 minutos."

deploy-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-216543 (eu-west latency spike) — assigned to infra oncall. :robot_face:

ana: assigning actions: jess — publish statuspage now + push translations; marc — send registrant note + tag demo leads; lucas — pause social + update webinar landing to show 'holding' state; tom — update ops channel with ETA changes. I'll check back at +15.

jess: publishing now. will post the +15 update as a thread reply.

marc: sending registrant note now, routing new demo leads to incident-queue. SDRs notified.

lucas: social paused. removing scheduled benchmark snippets for today.

ana: thanks team. keep replies short here and ping me if anything changes outside these windows. :thumbsup:
